title: Minecraft: Clumped
description: This datapack adds nice quality of life features for builders playing survival mode. Currently these are crafting recipes for items that are often used in building or for other purposes but don't have crafting recipes.
body:
# What is MC: Clumped?
MC: Clumped is a Minecraft datapack by content creator Clump that adds new crafting recipes, mostly for building materials.

The datapack focuses on blocks that are useful for building in survival mode but are rarely used due to poor accessibility or the lack of crafting recipes, making survival building more flexible and rewarding.
